project_metadata.title: InkluTrack: AI-Enabled Lifecycle-Based Smart Application for PWD Productivity Development: From Enrollment to Job Placement
project_metadata.college: College of Information and Computing Science
project_metadata.degree: Bachelor of Science in Information Technology

chapter_1_introduction.problem_background: Vocational PWD tracking environments are heavily fragmented across silos. Staff at AVRC Region IX report that manual tooling complicates record consolidation, trailing behavioral vectors, and tracking active placements.
chapter_1_introduction.solution_proposed: InkluTrack unifies intake, assessment logs, productivity metrics, AI-driven risk scoring, and structural employer matching into one screen-reader compliant interface.
governing_mandates: Republic Act 7277 (Magna Carta for Disabled Persons)

objectives.general: Design and develop InkluTrack as an end-to-end client lifecycle tracking ecosystem with AI insights to speed up rehabilitation and occupational placement timelines.

specific.task: Design system data schemas, UX matrices, and AI connection hooks
Develop core software registry, logging records, and profile sheets
Integrate AI productivity risk pipelines and candidate-vacancy vectors
Launch placement funnels, internship reviews, and feedback tracking
Perform system usability evaluations checking for an SUS score of 70+

in_scope: AVRC Region IX center lifecycle tracking
Tabular data AI risk and matching models
Web-based responsive execution with accessibility features
out_of_scope: External payment gateways and automated corporate HRIS hooks
Live internet scraping for outside labor vacancies

chapter_2_technical_architecture.presentation_layer: React or Vue with TypeScript, featuring WCAG accessibility configurations and ARIA markup.
chapter_2_technical_architecture.application_layer: Node.js (Express or NestJS) handling JWT/OAuth2 RBAC structures and system tasks.
chapter_2_technical_architecture.data_layer: PostgreSQL relational operational store combined with object stores for system files.
chapter_2_technical_architecture.ai_analytics_layer: Python FastAPI serving scikit-learn, XGBoost, and LightGBM models with SHAP-based model interpretability maps.

non_functional_requirements.metric: Full compliance with WCAG 2.1 AA specifications
P95 execution latency capped under 2.5 seconds
TLS 1.2+ network transfers; AES-256 at rest encryption; bcrypt cost factor >= 10
Horizontal architecture scaling with stateless API layers
Test suite coverage values >= 70% with strict lint parameters
Full operations supported across latest 2 versions of modern web browsers
Model evaluation metrics at F1 score >= 0.70; Top-5 prediction match rates >= 0.75
Mandatory DPA-aligned DPIA mapping and encryption keys
Cryptographic logging tracking 100% of sensitive platform updates
Built-in i18n configurations featuring English and Filipino text options
